heroes.name: Katsu
heroes.description: Searches the deck for combo pieces and chains them into long attack sequences.

heroes.name: Benji
heroes.description: Relies on many small, hard-to-block attacks and constant pressure.

heroes.name: Ira
heroes.description: Smoothly chains many small attacks and benefits from precise timing and Go Again.

heroes.name: Lexi
heroes.description: Switches between ice and lightning strategies, pressuring the opponent with ranged attacks.

heroes.name: Azalea
heroes.description: Prepares individual arrows with precision and enhances them with powerful hit effects.

heroes.name: Riptide
heroes.description: Uses traps and reactions to punish enemy actions and create defensive advantages.

heroes.name: Uzuri
heroes.description: Trades attacks during the combat chain and surprises with unexpected effects.

heroes.name: Arakni
heroes.description: Plays patiently, disrupts the opponent's game plan, and uses banish and control mechanics.

heroes.name: Rhinar
heroes.description: Brutally and relentlessly attacks the opponent, using wild combat tricks to maintain his frenzy.

heroes.name: Briar
heroes.description: Combines actions and attacks into long chains, linking physical and arcane damage.

heroes.name: Viserai
heroes.description: Summons dark powers in rituals to draw strength from them. Attacks mercilessly with demonic power.

heroes.name: Kano
heroes.description: Uses aggressive elemental magic to deal unrelenting damage and also uses clairvoyance to see future steps.

heroes.name: Dorinthea
heroes.description: Plays patiently, disrupts the opponent's game plan, and uses banish and control mechanics.

heroes.name: Brevant
heroes.description: Blocks efficiently and uses heavy attacks to control the pace of the game.

heroes.name: Oldhim
heroes.description: Defends exceptionally strongly, prevents damage, and slows the game flow. Commands the powers of earth and ice.

heroes.name: Professor Teklovossen
heroes.description: Builds machines and Hyper Drivers, gathers resources, and unleashes strength over several turns through constructs and inventions.
